name: Sergeant Odessa
title: Waykeeper Sergeant
examine: Runs the outpost like a kitchen: everything sharp, everything where her hand expects it. Her watch reports are famously two words long.
lines: You want stories, the crofters sell them with the eggs. Here we sell quiet, and it's paid for nightly.
The old line's towers stand empty north of here. We don't relight them. Ask me at dusk and I'll tell you why we don't have to.
